Danish

Etymology

Originally the neuter of an adjective corresponding to Old Norse heldri (“bigger”), see heldr (“rather”).

Adverb

hellere

  1. rather (preference)
    Jeg vil hellere til Sydafrika.
    I would rather go to South Africa.

Derived terms

  • hellere end gerne

Related terms

  • helst

References

  • “hellere” in Den Danske Ordbog
